absent: Vendor specific virtualization enable, disable, virtual machine init and pre destroy behavior beyond the delegation points is not shown.
Exact time stamp frequency discovery, maximum frequency selection, and guest clock base computation are not shown.
Full instruction emulation dispatch and page fault handling beyond type flags and task switch codes are not shown.
Interrupt controller virtualization activation and map update protocol beyond lock init and inhibit reasons are not shown.
Xen shared info mapping, event channel port allocation lifecycle, and hypercall parameter handling beyond completion helpers are not shown.
Active dirty ring implementation when enabled, including allocation sizing and reset accounting, is not shown because only the fallback is present.
Secure encrypted state port and memory operation setup before completion, including initial fragment construction and residual count creation, is not shown.
Interrupt routing table management and bus device attachment beyond range descriptors and limits are not shown.

findings.text: The architecture virtual machine creation entry validates the requested guest type, records type derived flags for private memory and pre fault permission, masks disabled quirks from capability sets, initializes page tracking and address translation structures in order with cleanup on failure, delegates to vendor specific initialization, zeroes the noncoherent device counter, prepares timekeeping and interrupt mapping locks and rate control, establishes a base guest clock offset and guest visible defaults for time stamp frequency and bus timing and platform info and performance monitoring, initializes acceleration and HyperV and Xen state, warns once about an unsupported register handling combination, and prepares one time execution state for non execution handling.

The architecture pre destroy entry stops time based and background device activity before reclaiming virtual processors, flushes programmed timer and interrupt controller work synchronously, invokes address translation pre teardown and then vendor specific pre teardown, while intentionally retaining interrupt routing structures until virtual processors are gone because concurrent iteration over virtual processors during free would be unsafe.

One helper returns the guest instruction address for performance sampling, asserting that sampling is in guest context and returning zero when guest state is protected, otherwise reading the current instruction pointer. A second helper reports whether a virtual processor needs a kick based on whether it is currently inside guest mode.

Registration and unregistration maintain a counter of assigned noncoherent direct memory access devices. The transition from zero to one and from one to zero triggers a helper that may invalidate all guest physical mappings so that new entries observe the correct treatment of guest page attributes.

Shared initialization support for guest memory is reported as allowed exactly when the virtual machine does not use private memory. Reclamation of guest memory pages is delegated to vendor specific logic that returns pages to shared state.

Xen specific virtual machine initialization prepares mutual exclusion for Xen state, initializes an identifier allocator for event channel ports, and initializes cached access to shared information. A separate header provides an empty variant for builds without Xen support.

Xen hypercall completion from userspace first checks that the virtual processor still resides at the recorded hypercall address and otherwise completes immediately without further action, and when resident it installs the result supplied by userspace. Event channel signaling through interrupt routing succeeds only for asserted level and otherwise rejects the request. A poll timeout handler requests an unblock and kicks the virtual processor to cancel waiting.

The architecture shutdown entry marks a global rebooting flag to indicate that virtualization instructions may fault and such faults should be ignored, with a write barrier ensuring visibility before inter processor interrupts disable virtualization elsewhere. The per processor disable entry invokes vendor specific disable and then either releases user return notification state when in task context or when expected, or pins the module to defend against unload racing with reboot in the interrupt path.

Module initialization prepares extended processor state size information, initializes address translation module state, and narrows a return buffer mitigation to systems that both report the relevant hardware issue and allow simultaneous multithreading. Module exit asserts that a static key tracking absence of interrupt controller state is not unexpectedly active.

When backward movement of the host time stamp counter is observed after resume, the implementation computes a cycle delta from the maximum and local readings, marks every virtual machine as having observed backward time, adds the same delta to the adjustment of every virtual processor and refreshes its last host reading while requesting a master clock update, and clears last time stamp bookkeeping to disable offset matching. The adjustment runs once for all processors and is skipped on platforms without reliable counters.

Secure encrypted virtualization with encrypted state completes emulated memory mapped input output in fragments of up to eight bytes. Each completion copies data from userspace for reads, advances within the current fragment or to the next fragment, clears the pending flag and finishes when all fragments are consumed, otherwise prepares the next userspace exit and re arms itself as the completion handler.

Emulated port output completion clears the transfer count and either re issues vendor handling while residual secure data remains or finishes. Emulated port input completion delivers buffered secure data to the emulator, advances the emulated port position by the transferred amount, and similarly continues while residual data remains or finishes.

Virtual machine type determines private memory exactly for software protected guests and allows pre fault exactly for default and software protected types. Disabled quirks are the intersection of inapplicable and supported capability quirks. Default time stamp frequency prefers a measured maximum when present and otherwise uses a base rate. Bus period uses a fixed default, platform information reads are initially allowed, and performance monitoring enablement follows a global switch unless protected monitoring is present.

Invalidation of all guest mappings on first assignment or last release of noncoherent devices occurs only when the virtual machine has the quirk that ignores guest page attributes. When guest attributes are always honored no invalidation is performed.

Instruction address reporting is valid only during guest performance sampling and yields zero for protected state. Kick requests are required exactly while the target is in guest mode and not otherwise.

The fallback dirty ring implementation reports zero reserved entries, always selects dirty bitmap tracking, reports successful allocation without action, reports missing entry on reset, performs no action on push, returns no page on lookup, and performs no action on free.

Virtual machine creation initializes a raw spin lock for time stamp writes, a mutex for interrupt mapping, a sequence counter bound to the time stamp lock for paravirtual clock reads, and conditionally a spin lock for HyperV translation roots, plus a mutex for Xen state in Xen initialization. Time base publication holds the time stamp lock with interrupts saved. Pre destroy ordering relies on synchronous cancellation rather than holding these locks across teardown.

The dirty ring descriptor holds a producer position and a consumer reset position, a capacity and a soft limit threshold, a pointer to an array of dirty guest frame entries, and an index identifying the ring.

An input output range descriptor pairs a guest address with a length and a device pointer. A bus descriptor holds device and event counts with deferred reclamation support followed by a flexible array of ranges. The bus enumeration distinguishes memory mapped, port, virtio channel notify, fast memory mapped, configuration space, and a count sentinel.

The event channel file descriptor descriptor stores a send port and a type tag plus a delivery union. One union member carries kernel event channel addressing while the other carries a zero port with an event file context for userspace notification.

Compatibility virtual processor information packs pending and mask bytes with padding and a pending selector plus architecture control register state and paravirtual clock time, sized to sixty four bytes on x86. Compatibility shared information arrays per processor info with pending and mask word arrays, wall clock, and architecture fields for address limits and translation roots and generation and high seconds.

Compatibility run state packs a state code with entry time and four time counters. Compatibility scheduling poll carries a guest address for ports with a count and timeout. Compatibility single shot timer packs an absolute timeout in nanoseconds with flags.

Maximum virtual processor identifiers equal maximum virtual processors. Maximum memory mapped fragments is two. Address space count is one. Slot flags use bit sixteen for invalid and bit seventeen for guest memory only. Generation update in progress uses the top bit of sixty four. Bus device limit is one thousand.

Page frame error codes occupy high bits starting at position fifty two with an eleven bit mask and a twelve bit mask for missing slot detection, with missing slot indicated by the top bit alone and fault, poison, read only fault, signal pending and needs input output as successive values above the base mask. Host address error sentinels are page offset and page offset plus one page for read only failures.

Request identifiers use the low eight bits with single bits at positions eight, nine and ten for no wakeup, wait, and no action. Generic requests assign zero to translation flush with wait and no wakeup, one to virtual machine dead with wait and no wakeup, two to unblock, three to dirty ring soft full, with architecture requests starting at eight. Outside guest mode combines no action with wait and no wakeup. Architecture request construction validates the index against the request word size minus the base and adds the base with flags.
Interrupt source identifiers assign zero to userspace, one to resampling file descriptors, and two to the programmable timer.

Emulation type flags occupy bits zero through nine for no decode, trap undefined, skip, allow retry of faults, forced trap undefined, VMware guest protection, page fault, complete user exit, write fault to shadow page, and skip software interrupts. Task switch reasons assign zero to call, one to return, two to jump, and three to gate.

Maximum machine check banks is thirty two. Memory slot hash sizing is twice the identifier hash size per address space. Paravirtual spinlock defaults use a gap of one hundred twenty eight, grow factor two, shrink zero, Intel window four thousand ninety six with maximum unsigned integer value, AMD window three thousand with maximum unsigned short value. The any guest address sentinel is all bits set.

Virtual interrupt acceleration inhibit reasons start with generic causes for disabled support, HyperV auto end of interrupt use, absent interrupt chip, blocked interrupts for debugging, aliased physical identifiers without hotplug handling, and guest modified interrupt identifier or base from reset values.

Remaining inhibit reasons are specific to AMD virtual interrupt handling for nested guests, interrupt window waits, timer reinjection relying on end of interrupt interception, secure encrypted virtualization, aliased logical identifiers, and physical identifiers beyond supported size, followed by a count sentinel. A helper macro pairs each reason bit with its name for tracing.

Include guards define unique macros for x86 KVM, Xen, dirty ring, and host headers. The nested entry consistency helper evaluates a supplied check, emits a trace naming the check on failure, and yields whether it failed. The compatibility two level event channel count is eight times the size of the pending array in compatibility shared information. The Xen log prefix prepends the module name.

When no virtual processor runs between suspend cycles, elapsed time can be missed uniformly because the last host reading is reset, which is considered tolerable. A faster second resume could observe a smaller counter and require extra padding, which is handled by updating the stored reading. Platforms with unreliable counters rely on catchup mode that restores real time without guaranteeing tight synchronization.

Forced reboot without frozen tasks can race module unload against user return state updates during inter processor disable, so the interrupt path pins the module instead of releasing notifications. Releasing notifications in task context versus pinning in interrupt context must be distinguished to avoid use after free.

Running with ignored missing registers silenced is unsupported and may hang or mislead guests. Operators are directed to report guests that need it. Event channel routing must reject deasserted level to avoid spurious signaling.
